title.zh: 第 17 章 測驗檢討
title.en: Chapter 17 Quiz Review

intro.zh: 這份測驗共 37 分：甲部 5 題多項選擇題（10 分）、乙部 5 條長題目（27 分），另有一題 3 分加分題。
intro.en: The quiz is out of 37 marks: five multiple-choice questions in Section A (10 marks), five conventional questions in Section B (27 marks), plus a 3-mark bonus question.

title.zh: 甲部 · 多項選擇題
title.en: Section A · Multiple choice

stem.en: A box contains 9 red balls and 7 blue balls. If a person randomly selects 4 balls from the box, how many different combinations of balls are possible if at least two blue balls must be selected?
stem.zh: 一個盒子裡有 $9$ 個紅球和 $7$ 個藍球。若隨機從盒中選出 $4$ 個球，而最少要選到兩個藍球，共有多少種不同的選法？（原卷第 1 題）

keywords.zh: 最少兩個藍球（＝2、3 或 4 個藍球）
組合（只問選法，不問次序）
一次過選 4 個（不是逐個取，不會重複）

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 先讀清楚「最少兩個」
title.en: Step 1 · Read 'at least two' carefully

steps.zh: 「最少兩個藍球」＝2 個、3 個或 4 個藍球。正面分三個情況要計三次，用「反面」最快：由總數減去「0 個藍球」和「1 個藍球」兩種不合的情況。
steps.en: 'At least two blue balls' means 2, 3 or 4 blue balls. Instead of counting three cases, use the complement: take the total and subtract the cases with 0 blue balls and with 1 blue ball.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 先算總數
title.en: Step 2 · Start with the total

steps.zh: 盒中一共有 $9 + 7 = 16$ 個球。任選 $4$ 個的總數是 $C^{16}_4 = \frac{16 \times 15 \times 14 \times 13}{4 \times 3 \times 2 \times 1} = 1820$ 種。
steps.en: There are 9 + 7 = 16 balls in the box, so selecting any 4 of them gives C(16,4) = 1820 ways.

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 減去「0 個藍球」
title.en: Step 3 · Subtract the '0 blue balls' case

steps.zh: 0 個藍球＝4 個球全部來自 9 個紅球，有 $C^9_4 = 126$ 種。
steps.en: Zero blue balls means all 4 balls come from the 9 red ones: C(9,4) = 126 ways.

title.zh: 第 4 步 · 減去「剛好 1 個藍球」
title.en: Step 4 · Subtract the 'exactly 1 blue ball' case

steps.zh: 1 個藍球：由 7 個藍球中選 1 個（$C^7_1 = 7$）；另外 3 個要由 9 個紅球中選（$C^9_3 = 84$）。兩件事分步進行，用乘法：$7 \times 84 = 588$ 種。
steps.en: One blue ball: choose 1 from the 7 blue balls (C(7,1) = 7) and the other 3 from the 9 red balls (C(9,3) = 84). These are two steps, so multiply: 7 × 84 = 588 ways.

title.zh: 第 5 步 · 相減得答案
title.en: Step 5 · Subtract to finish

steps.en: So the number of ways with at least 2 blue balls is 1820 − 126 − 588 = 1106. The answer is C.

traps.zh: A（$588$）＝$C^7_1 C^9_3$，這是「剛好 1 個藍球」的數目。題目要「最少 2 個藍球」，這 588 種正正是要減去的部分，不是答案。
traps.en: A (588) = C(7,1)C(9,3), the number of ways with exactly 1 blue ball. Since the question asks for at least 2 blue balls, those 588 ways are part of what must be subtracted, not the answer.

traps.zh: B（$714$）＝$126 + 588$，這是「最多 1 個藍球」（0 個或 1 個），與題目的條件剛好相反。可作核對：$714 + 1106 = 1820$，即兩邊合起來才是總數。
traps.en: B (714) = 126 + 588, the number of ways with at most one blue ball — the opposite of what is asked. As a check: 714 + 1106 = 1820, the total.

traps.zh: D（$1820$）＝$C^{16}_4$，這是任選 4 個球的總數，完全沒有理會「最少 2 個藍球」這個條件。
traps.en: D (1820) = C(16,4), the total number of ways to select 4 balls, ignoring the 'at least two blue balls' condition completely.

tip.zh: 有「最少／至少」的題目，先看反面是否只有一兩個情況：這裡「不合」的只有 0 個和 1 個藍球，比正面分三種情況快得多。
tip.en: For 'at least' questions, check whether the complement has only one or two cases: here 'not allowed' means 0 or 1 blue ball, much quicker than three cases.

stem.en: A display case has two separate rows. In the upper row, 5 distinct silver medals are to be displayed in a line. In the lower row, 3 distinct gold medals are to be displayed in a line. Find the number of different ways to arrange these medals.
stem.zh: 一個陳列櫃有上下兩行。上行要把 $5$ 面不同的銀牌排成一行，下行要把 $3$ 面不同的金牌排成一行。求排列這些獎牌的方法數目。（原卷第 2 題）

keywords.zh: 上下兩行（兩行各自排，互不影響）
獎牌互不相同（同一行內要排序）
排成一行（次序不同＝不同排法）

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 兩行各自排列
title.en: Step 1 · Arrange each row on its own

steps.zh: 上行 5 面銀牌全部要排成一行，而且每面都不同，有 $5! = 120$ 種排法（5 個位置逐個揀：$5 \times 4 \times 3 \times 2 \times 1$）。下行 3 面金牌同樣處理：$3! = 6$ 種。
steps.en: The 5 distinct silver medals in the upper row can be arranged in 5! = 120 ways. The 3 distinct gold medals in the lower row: 3! = 6 ways.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 分步用乘（不是分類用加）
title.en: Step 2 · Multiply — the rows are consecutive steps

steps.zh: 排好上行之後再排下行，這是「分步」而不是「分類」，所以兩行相乘：$120 \times 6 = 720$ 種。答案是 C。
steps.en: Arranging the upper row and then the lower row are consecutive steps, so multiply: 120 × 6 = 720 ways. Answer C.

traps.zh: A（$126$）＝$5! + 3! = 120 + 6$，把兩行的數目相加。兩行是「先排上行、再排下行」的分步關係，必須相乘；相加只在「分類」（幾個互斥情況）時才用。
traps.en: A (126) = 5! + 3! = 120 + 6, adding the two rows. The rows are consecutive steps, so multiply; addition is only for separate cases.

traps.zh: B（$360$）＝$5! \times 3 = 120 \times 3$，把 3 面金牌的內部排列當成「3 種」，即用了 3 而忘記 $3! = 6$。3 面金牌互不相同，自己排有 $3! = 6$ 種。
traps.en: B (360) = 5! × 3 = 120 × 3, using 3 instead of 3! = 6 for the gold medals. The three gold medals are distinct, so they can be arranged in 3! = 6 ways.

traps.zh: D（$40320$）＝$8!$，把 8 面獎牌當成一排全部一起排。題目分成上下兩行：銀牌只在上行、金牌只在下行，不能混在一起。這一題不少人其實畫對了圖：紙上明明有上下兩排橫線（5 條、3 條），落計數機時卻直接按了 $8!$。畫好圖之後要把算式寫出來（$5! \times 3!$），唔好靠感覺跳步。
traps.en: D (40320) = 8!, arranging all 8 medals in one single line. The medals are in two separate rows: silver in the upper row, gold in the lower row. Many papers show the right picture — two rows of dashes (5 and 3) drawn beside the question — yet 8! still appears on the calculator. Once the picture is drawn, write the expression down (5! × 3!) instead of jumping straight to the calculator.

tip.zh: 「A 有 m 種、B 有 n 種」時先問：是分類（用加）還是分步（用乘）？並檢查每一組內部是否還有次序（要用 $P$ 或階乘）。
tip.en: When group A has m ways and group B has n ways, ask first: are they separate cases (add) or consecutive steps (multiply)? Then check whether each group is itself ordered (use P or factorials).

stem.en: A club consists of 11 teachers and 9 students. If a delegation of 5 members is to be formed from the group such that there are exactly 2 teachers in the delegation, how many different delegations can be formed?
stem.zh: 一個俱樂部有 $11$ 位老師和 $9$ 位學生。若要從中組成一個 $5$ 人代表團，而代表團中剛好有 $2$ 位老師，共有多少個不同的代表團？（原卷第 3 題）

keywords.zh: 剛好 2 位老師（即 2 位老師 ＋ 3 位學生）
5 人代表團（一組人，不計次序 → 用 $C$）
從 11 位老師與 9 位學生中分別選人

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 「剛好 2 位老師」＝2 位老師 ＋ 3 位學生
title.en: Step 1 · 'Exactly 2 teachers' means 2 teachers + 3 students

steps.zh: 代表團共 5 人，其中剛好 2 位老師，所以餘下 $5 - 2 = 3$ 位一定是學生。選人的工作分成兩部分：先選老師，再選學生。
steps.en: The delegation has 5 members with exactly 2 teachers, so the other 5 − 2 = 3 members must be students. The work splits into two parts: choose the teachers, then the students.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 選老師（不計次序，用組合）
title.en: Step 2 · Choose the teachers (order ignored, use C)

steps.zh: 由 11 位老師中選 2 位，只是「一組人」，甲乙誰先被叫到沒有分別，所以用組合 $C^{11}_2 = 55$ 種。
steps.en: Choose 2 of the 11 teachers. The order does not matter, so use a combination: C(11,2) = 55 ways.

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 選學生
title.en: Step 3 · Choose the students

steps.zh: 由 9 位學生中選 3 位，同樣用組合 $C^9_3 = 84$ 種。
steps.en: Choose 3 of the 9 students: C(9,3) = 84 ways.

title.zh: 第 4 步 · 兩步相乘
title.en: Step 4 · Multiply the two steps

steps.zh: 每一種選老師的方法都可以配上任何一種選學生的方法，所以相乘：$55 \times 84 = 4620$ 個代表團。答案是 A。
steps.en: Every choice of teachers can be paired with every choice of students, so multiply: 55 × 84 = 4620 delegations. Answer A.

traps.zh: B（$5940$）＝$C^{11}_3 \times C^9_2$：老師與學生的數目調轉了（變成 3 位老師、2 位學生）。題目指定「剛好 2 位老師」，所以老師選 2 位、學生選 3 位。
traps.en: B (5940) = C(11,3) × C(9,2): the roles are swapped (3 teachers, 2 students). The question fixes exactly 2 teachers, so choose 2 teachers and 3 students.

traps.zh: C（$15504$）＝$C^{20}_5$，這是 20 人（11 ＋ 9）中任選 5 人的總數，完全沒有考慮「剛好 2 位老師」這個限制。
traps.en: C (15504) = C(20,5), the total number of ways to choose any 5 of the 20 people, ignoring the 'exactly 2 teachers' restriction.

traps.zh: D（$55440$）＝$P^{11}_2 \times P^9_3 = 110 \times 504$，用了排列而不是組合。代表團只是一組人，次序不影響結果；如果選出的人之後還要「分配職位」才需要用 $P$。
traps.en: D (55440) = P(11,2) × P(9,3) = 110 × 504, using permutations instead of combinations. A delegation is just a set of people; P would only be needed if the chosen members were then given different posts.

tip.zh: 「選一組人」一律用 $C$；「分配給不同位置／任務」才用 $P$。先寫出人數分配（例如 2 師 ＋ 3 生），再逐部分用 $C$，最後相乘。
tip.en: Selecting a group always uses C; assigning people to different posts or tasks uses P. Write down the make-up first (e.g. 2 teachers + 3 students), then use C for each part and multiply.

stem.en: A committee of 5 members is to be formed from a group of 15 teachers and 10 students. If the committee must have more teachers than students, how many different committees can be formed?
stem.zh: 要從 $15$ 位老師和 $10$ 位學生中組成一個 $5$ 人委員會。若委員會中的老師必須多過學生，共有多少個不同的委員會？（原卷第 4 題）

keywords.zh: 老師多過學生（有三種情況：3-2、4-1、5-0）
5 人委員會（不計次序 → 用 $C$）
互斥情況（分類相加）

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 把「老師多過學生」寫成不等式
title.en: Step 1 · Turn 'more teachers than students' into an inequality

steps.math: T + S = 5,\quad T > S \Rightarrow T > 5 - T \Rightarrow 2T > 5 \Rightarrow T \ge 3
steps.zh: 設委員會中有 $T$ 位老師、$S$ 位學生。$T + S = 5$；「老師多過學生」即 $T > S$。把 $S = 5 - T$ 代入：$T > 5 - T$，得 $2T > 5$，$T > 2.5$。人數是整數，所以 $T \ge 3$。
steps.en: Let the committee have T teachers and S students. Then T + S = 5, and 'more teachers than students' means T > S. Substituting S = 5 − T gives T > 5 − T, so 2T > 5 and T > 2.5. Since T is a whole number, T ≥ 3.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 列出三個互斥情況
title.en: Step 2 · List the three mutually exclusive cases

steps.zh: 老師最多 15 人、學生最多 10 人，所以 $T$ 可以是 3、4 或 5，對應（3 師 2 生）、（4 師 1 生）、（5 師 0 生）三個情況。三個情況互不重疊（互斥），最後把它們相加。
steps.en: T can be 3, 4 or 5, giving the three cases (3 teachers, 2 students), (4 teachers, 1 student) and (5 teachers, 0 students). These cases never overlap, so add them at the end.

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 逐個情況用組合計數
title.en: Step 3 · Count each case with combinations

title.zh: 第 4 步 · 互斥情況相加
title.en: Step 4 · Add the cases

steps.zh: 三個情況合起來就是所有「老師多過學生」的委員會：$20475 + 13650 + 3003 = 37128$ 個。答案是 B。
steps.en: The three cases together cover every committee with more teachers than students: 20 475 + 13 650 + 3003 = 37 128. Answer B.

traps.en: A (17 160) matches none of the valid case counts (20 475, 13 650, 3003) nor the opposite 'fewer teachers than students' total (12 600 + 3150 + 252 = 16 002). It usually comes from mis-splitting or mis-evaluating the cases. Listing the three mutually exclusive cases and adding gives 37 128 (B).

traps.zh: C（$53130$）＝$C^{25}_5$，這是 25 人（15 ＋ 10）中任選 5 人的總數，完全沒有考慮「老師多過學生」這個限制。
traps.en: C (53 130) = C(25,5), the total number of ways to choose any 5 of the 25 people, ignoring the 'more teachers than students' condition.
D (20 475) = C(15,3)C(10,2), only the '3 teachers, 2 students' case. Since T > 2.5, T can be 3, 4 or 5 — all three cases count.

tip.zh: 「A 多過 B」的題目：先用不等式把可行的整數情況全部找出來，逐個情況用組合相乘，最後把互斥情況相加。
tip.en: For 'more A than B' questions: use an inequality to find every possible whole-number case, count each case with combinations, then add the mutually exclusive cases.

stem.en: 6 boys and 4 girls are arranged in a line for a photograph. If no girls stand next to each other, how many different arrangements are possible?
stem.zh: $6$ 名男生和 $4$ 名女生排成一行拍照。若沒有女生是相鄰的，共有多少種不同的排法？（原卷第 5 題）

keywords.en: no girls stand next to each other
keywords.zh: 沒有女生相鄰（＝插空法）
排成一行（次序不同＝不同排法）
空隙要連最前、最後都數（$6+1=7$ 個）

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 插空法：先排沒有受限制的男生
title.en: Step 1 · Slot-in method: arrange the unrestricted boys first

steps.zh: 4 名女生「不可相鄰」，用插空法：先排沒有受限制的 6 名男生。6 名男生都是不同的人，排成一行有 $6! = 720$ 種。
steps.en: No two girls may be adjacent, so use the slot-in method: arrange the 6 unrestricted boys first. The 6 boys are all different, giving 6! = 720 arrangements.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 數空隙（記得兩端）
title.en: Step 2 · Count the gaps (include both ends)

steps.zh: 排好男生之後，他們前後及之間形成空隙：最前 1 個、男生之間 5 個、最後 1 個，共 $6 + 1 = 7$ 個。把女生放入這些空隙，就保證沒有兩個女生相鄰（同一個空隙最多放 1 個女生）。
steps.en: Once the boys are arranged, the gaps are: 1 before the first boy, 5 between them and 1 after the last boy, i.e. 6 + 1 = 7 gaps. Putting girls into distinct gaps guarantees that no two girls are adjacent.

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 女生是不同的人，要用排列
title.en: Step 3 · The girls are distinct, so use P

steps.zh: 由 7 個空隙中揀 4 個放入 4 名女生：選空隙之後，4 名女生誰坐哪個空隙有分別，所以用排列 $P^7_4 = 840$ 種（不是 $C^7_4 = 35$）。
steps.en: Choose 4 of the 7 gaps and place the 4 distinct girls: the assignment of girls to gaps matters, so use P(7,4) = 840 (not C(7,4) = 35).

title.zh: 第 4 步 · 兩步相乘
title.en: Step 4 · Multiply the two steps

steps.zh: 先排男生、再插女生是「分步」，所以相乘：$6! \times P^7_4 = 720 \times 840 = 604800$ 種。答案是 D。
steps.en: Arranging the boys then slotting in the girls are consecutive steps, so multiply: 6! × P(7,4) = 720 × 840 = 604 800. Answer D.

traps.zh: A（$259200$）＝$6! \times P^6_4 = 720 \times 360$，空隙數目少了一個（用了 6 個）。6 名男生前後及之間一共有 $6 + 1 = 7$ 個空隙，漏了最前或最後一個，就會變成 $P^6_4 = 360$。
traps.en: A (259 200) = 6! × P(6,4) = 720 × 360, using 6 gaps instead of 7. The 6 boys create 6 + 1 = 7 gaps; missing out one end gives P(6,4) = 360.

traps.zh: B（$25200$）＝$6! \times C^7_4 = 720 \times 35$，空隙數目對了，但用了「組合」$C^7_4$。4 名女生是不同的人，放入空隙時有先後之別，要用排列 $P^7_4 = 840$。
traps.en: B (25 200) = 6! × C(7,4) = 720 × 35. The number of gaps is right, but a combination was used. The 4 girls are distinct, so P(7,4) = 840 is needed.

traps.zh: C（$3507840$）＝$10! - 7! \times 4!$，想用「反面」（全部 − 女生相鄰的情況），但 $7! \times 4! = 120960$ 只計了「4 名女生全部連成一個 block」這一種，並未排除「兩個女生相鄰、另外兩個也相鄰」等情況，所以減得不夠。
traps.en: C (3 507 840) = 10! − 7! × 4!, an attempted complement. But 7! × 4! = 120 960 only counts the case where all 4 girls form one block; it does not remove cases such as two separate adjacent pairs, so too little is subtracted.

tip.zh: 插空法三步：① 先排無限制的物件 ② 數空隙（$n$ 個物件有 $n+1$ 個空隙，兩端要數） ③ 把有分別的物件用 $P$ 放入空隙。
tip.en: Slot-in in three steps: (1) arrange the unrestricted objects, (2) count the gaps (n objects give n + 1 gaps, including both ends), (3) place the distinct restricted objects into the gaps using P.

title.zh: 乙部 · 長題目
title.en: Section B · Conventional questions

stem.en: A shopping mall has 4 entrances A, B, C and D. Miss Wong enters and leaves the mall once today.
stem.zh: 某商場有 4 個入口 A、B、C、D。黃小姐今天進入商場一次，離開一次。（原卷第 6 題）

keywords.en: enters and leaves the mall once
keywords.zh: 入一次、出一次（兩次選擇各自獨立）

keywords.en: does not enter the mall via entrance A or entrance D
keywords.zh: 「不經 A 或 D 進入」＝A、D 兩個都不能用

keywords.en: does not leave the mall via entrance C
keywords.zh: 「不由 C 離開」＝只排除 C 一個

parts.label: (a)
parts.en: Find the number of different ways that she enters and leaves the mall.
parts.zh: 求她進入和離開商場的不同方法數目。

parts.label: (b)
parts.en: If she does not enter the mall via entrance A or entrance D, and does not leave the mall via entrance C, find the number of different ways that she enters and leaves the mall.
parts.zh: 若她不由入口 A 或入口 D 進入，且不由入口 C 離開，求她進入和離開商場的不同方法數目。

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 入和出是兩次獨立的選擇
title.en: Step 1 · Entering and leaving are two independent choices

steps.zh: 進入商場有 4 個入口可揀（A、B、C、D）；離開商場同樣有 4 個出口可揀。題目沒有要求「入和出要用不同入口」，所以兩次選擇各自獨立，用乘法原理。
steps.en: She can enter through any of the 4 entrances (A, B, C, D), and leave through any of the 4 as well. Nothing says she must use different entrances, so the two choices are independent — multiply.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 計數
title.en: Step 2 · Evaluate

steps.zh: 所以共有 $4 \times 4 = 16$ 種不同的入、出方法。
steps.en: There are 4 × 4 = 16 different ways for her to enter and leave.

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 兩個條件分別限制哪一步
title.en: Step 3 · Which step does each condition restrict?

steps.zh: 「不經入口 A 或入口 D 進入」只影響「進入」的那一步：4 個入口減 2 個，剩 $4 - 2 = 2$ 個（即是 B、C）。「不由入口 C 離開」只影響「離開」的那一步：4 個出口減 1 個，剩 $4 - 1 = 3$ 個（即是 A、B、D）。注意 C 仍然可以用來進入，A、B、D 仍然可以用來離開。
steps.en: 'Does not enter via A or D' restricts only the entering step: 4 − 2 = 2 entrances remain (B and C). 'Does not leave via C' restricts only the leaving step: 4 − 1 = 3 exits remain (A, B and D). Note that C may still be used to enter, and A, B, D may still be used to leave.

title.zh: 第 4 步 · 相乘
title.en: Step 4 · Multiply

steps.zh: 兩步獨立，所以相乘：$2 \times 3 = 6$ 種。
steps.en: The two steps are independent, so multiply: 2 × 3 = 6 ways.

traps.label: (a) 把「入」和「出」當成同一次選擇
traps.labelEn: (a) Treating entering and leaving as one choice
traps.zh: 題目只說「進入一次、離開一次」，兩次是獨立的，可以經同一個入口出入，所以是 $4 \times 4 = 16$。若自行加上「入和出要用不同入口」的限制，就會算成 $4 \times 3 = 12$。
traps.en: The question only says she enters once and leaves once; the two choices are independent and the same entrance may be used twice, giving 4 × 4 = 16. Adding an extra 'must be different' restriction gives the wrong 4 × 3 = 12.

traps.label: (a) 把四個出入口拿去排次序（4! = 24）
traps.labelEn: (a) Putting the four entrances in order (4! = 24)
traps.zh: 四次「入／出」唔係四樣要排次序的東西：入有 4 個選擇、出又有 4 個選擇，兩步獨立，所以是 $4 \times 4 = 16$。寫成 $4! = 24$ 是把出入口排次序；寫成 $C^4_2 = 6$ 就係只從 4 個之中揀 2 個、仲當兩個一定要不同。全份卷都在考階乘、$P$ 和 $C$，這一題反而只要數「每一步有幾個選擇」。
traps.en: The four entrances are not four things to put in order: there are 4 choices for entering and 4 for leaving, independently, giving 4 × 4 = 16. Writing 4! = 24 orders the entrances; writing C(4,2) = 6 picks 2 of the 4 and assumes they must differ. The rest of the paper is full of factorials, P and C — this question only asks how many choices each step has.

traps.label: (a) 把四個出入口當成四個步驟（4 × 4 × 4 × 4 = 256）
traps.labelEn: (a) Treating the four entrances as four steps (4 × 4 × 4 × 4 = 256)
traps.zh: 行程只有兩步：進入一次、離開一次，每步 4 個選擇。$4 \times 4 \times 4 \times 4 = 256$ 係「四個出入口每次都要用到」的意思，題目沒有這個限制。
traps.en: There are only two steps — enter once and leave once — with 4 choices each. 4 × 4 × 4 × 4 = 256 would mean all four entrances must be used, which the question never says.

traps.label: (b) 兩個條件互相污染
traps.labelEn: (b) Letting one condition affect the other step
traps.zh: 「不經 A 或 D 進入」只在「進入」那一步扣 2 個；「不由 C 離開」只在「離開」那一步扣 1 個。若把兩個條件都套在兩步之上（例如兩邊都減 2），就會得出 $2 \times 2 = 4$ 這個常見錯答。
traps.en: 'Not via A or D' removes 2 options from the entering step only; 'not via C' removes 1 option from the leaving step only. Applying both conditions to both steps (e.g. subtracting 2 on each side) gives the common wrong answer 2 × 2 = 4.

traps.label: 把「不經 A 或 D」誤解為「A、D 之中只用一個不可以」
traps.labelEn: Misreading 'not via A or D'
traps.zh: 「不經入口 A 或入口 D」＝「A 不能用，D 也不能用」，兩個都要扣（剩 2 個），不是「A、D 之中只有一個不能用」（那樣會剩 3 個）。
traps.en: 'Does not enter via A or D' means neither A nor D may be used (2 left), not 'only one of A and D is excluded' (which would leave 3).

tip.zh: 先問「每個條件限制哪一步」，把兩種選擇的數目分別算清楚，最後才相乘；不要讓一個條件影響另一邊。
tip.en: First ask which step each condition restricts, work out the number of choices for each step separately, then multiply — never let one condition leak into the other step.

stem.en: 7 students sit in a row for a photograph. In each of the following, in how many different ways can they be arranged?
stem.zh: $7$ 位學生排成一行拍照。以下各情況分別有多少種不同的排法？（原卷第 7 題）

keywords.en: 2 particular students must sit next to each other
keywords.zh: 兩位指定的同學必須相鄰（＝綑綁法）

keywords.en: must not sit next to each other
keywords.zh: 必須不相鄰（＝全部 − 相鄰）
7 人排成一行（全部人都不同）

parts.label: (a)
parts.en: 2 particular students must sit next to each other.
parts.zh: 兩位指定的同學必須坐在一起。

parts.label: (b)
parts.en: 2 particular students must not sit next to each other.
parts.zh: 兩位指定的同學必須不相鄰。

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 綑綁法：把兩人綁成一塊
title.en: Step 1 · Tie the two students into one block

steps.zh: 兩位指定同學要相鄰，就把他們「綁成一塊」，當成一件物件。這塊連同其餘 5 位同學，合共 $5 + 1 = 6$ 件物件，排成一行有 $6!$ 種；塊內兩位同學左右互換又再有 $2!$ 種。兩個數要相乘（分步）。
steps.en: Tie the 2 particular students into one block. Together with the other 5 students, there are 5 + 1 = 6 objects, which can be arranged in 6! ways; inside the block the two students can swap, giving another 2!. Multiply the two (consecutive steps).

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 計算
title.en: Step 2 · Evaluate

steps.zh: 所以共有 $6! \times 2! = 720 \times 2 = 1440$ 種排法：先把 6 件物件排好，再處理塊內兩人的左右次序，兩步相乘。
steps.en: So there are 6! × 2! = 720 × 2 = 1440 arrangements.

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 反面做：全部 − 相鄰
title.en: Step 3 · Use the complement: all − adjacent

steps.zh: 沒有任何限制時，7 位同學全排列有 $7! = 5040$ 種。「不相鄰」＝全部減去「相鄰」，而「相鄰」的數目就是 (a) 的 $1440$。所以只要把 $7!$ 減去 $1440$。
steps.en: With no restriction the 7 students can be arranged in 7! = 5040 ways. 'Not adjacent' means all minus 'adjacent', and the number of 'adjacent' arrangements is exactly the 1440 found in (a). So subtract 1440 from 7!.

title.zh: 第 4 步 · 計算
title.en: Step 4 · Evaluate

steps.zh: 所以兩位指定同學不相鄰的排法共有 $5040 - 1440 = 3600$ 種。
steps.en: So the two particular students are not adjacent in 5040 − 1440 = 3600 of the arrangements.

name.zh: 方法二 · 插空法（先排其餘 5 人，再插入 2 人）
name.en: Method 2 · Insertion method (arrange the other 5 first, then slot the 2 in)

alt.zh:
先不理兩位指定同學，把其餘 5 位同學排好：$5! = 120$ 種。5 個人的前後及之間一共有 $5 + 1 = 6$ 個空隙（最前、最後各 1 個，加上他們之間的 4 個）。要令兩位指定同學不相鄰，只要把他們放入 6 個空隙之中不同的 2 個；空隙有先後之別（哪位站在較前的位置唔同），所以用 $P^6_2 = 6 \times 5 = 30$。分步相乘：$5! \times P^6_2 = 120 \times 30 = 3600$，與反面做法（$7! - 1440 = 3600$）相同 —— 考試用插空法一樣拿滿分。
用插空法還有個好處：唔需要靠 (a) 的答案，就算 (a) 做錯了，(b) 都照樣可以獨立計對。
alt.en:
Ignore the 2 particular students first and arrange the other 5: 5! = 120 ways. These 5 create 5 + 1 = 6 gaps (one at each end plus the 4 between them). To keep the 2 particular students apart, slot them into 2 different gaps; which gap comes first matters, so this is P(6,2) = 6 × 5 = 30. Multiply the two steps: 5! × P(6,2) = 120 × 30 = 3600 — the same as the complement method (7! − 1440 = 3600), and the insertion method also earns full marks.
The insertion method has one more advantage: it does not depend on the answer to (a), so (b) can be done correctly even if (a) went wrong.

traps.label: (a) 忘記塊內再排（漏乘 2!）
traps.labelEn: (a) Forgetting to arrange inside the block (missing 2!)
traps.zh: 綁成一塊之後只寫 $6! = 720$，就漏了塊內兩位同學可以左右互換（$2! = 2$ 種）。「相鄰」的數目是 $6! \times 2! = 1440$。
traps.en: Writing only 6! = 720 after tying the block misses the fact that the two students inside can swap (2! = 2). The number of adjacent arrangements is 6! × 2! = 1440.

traps.label: (b) 減錯數（用 6! 而不是 1440）
traps.labelEn: (b) Subtracting the wrong number (6! instead of 1440)
traps.zh: 反面做要減的是「兩位指定同學相鄰」的全部排法，即 (a) 的 $6! \times 2! = 1440$。若只減 $6! = 720$，會得 $5040 - 720 = 4320$，仍然是錯的。
traps.en: The complement removes every arrangement where the two particular students are adjacent, i.e. 6! × 2! = 1440 from (a). Subtracting only 6! = 720 gives 5040 − 720 = 4320, which is still wrong.

traps.label: (b) 直接寫 7! 當答案
traps.labelEn: (b) Writing 7! as the answer
traps.zh: $7! = 5040$ 是「無限制」的排法，不是「不相鄰」。題目問「必須不相鄰」，一定要扣起相鄰的 1440 種。
traps.en: 7! = 5040 is the number of unrestricted arrangements, not the number with no two adjacent. The 1440 adjacent arrangements must be removed.

tip.zh: 「相鄰」用綑綁法（塊內記得再排）；「不相鄰」用反面：總數 − 相鄰，直接用上一小題的答案最快。
tip.en: 'Adjacent' uses the tie-up method (remember the inside arrangements); 'not adjacent' uses the complement: all minus adjacent, reusing the previous part's answer.

stem.en: There are 5 actors and 3 actresses in a drama. In (a), all the performers stand in a row on the stage for the curtain call. In (b), they share their feelings one by one.
stem.zh: 一齣話劇有 $5$ 位男演員和 $3$ 位女演員。在 (a) 部，所有演員在台上排成一行謝幕；在 (b) 部，他們逐一分享感受。（原卷第 8 題）

keywords.en: no actresses stand next to each other
keywords.zh: 女演員互不相鄰（＝插空法）

keywords.en: share their feelings one by one
keywords.zh: 逐個分享（＝把出場次序排成一行）

keywords.en: the first two performers ... are male
keywords.zh: 首兩位分享的人是男性（指定位置要放男演員）

keywords.en: the second one, the fifth one and the last one
keywords.zh: 第 2、第 5 及最後一位（＝第 8 個位置）

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.en: Find the number of different arrangements if there is no restriction.
parts.zh: 若沒有任何限制，求不同的排列數目。

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.en: Find the number of different arrangements if no actresses stand next to each other.
parts.zh: 若女演員互不相鄰，求不同的排列數目。

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.en: Find the number of different sharing sequences if the first two performers who share their feelings are male.
parts.zh: 若首兩位分享感受的人是男性，求不同的分享次序數目。

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.en: Find the number of different sharing sequences if the 3 actresses are the second one, the fifth one and the last one to share their feelings respectively.
parts.zh: 若三位女演員分別是第 2 位、第 5 位及最後一位分享感受的人，求不同的分享次序數目。

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 無限制＝8 個人全排列
title.en: Step 1 · No restriction means arranging all 8 people

steps.zh: 8 位演員都是不同的人，排成一行就是全排列 $8! = 40320$ 種。（一行有 8 個位置，第 1 個位置 8 個選擇、第 2 個 7 個……如此類推。）
steps.en: The 8 performers are all distinct, so arranging them in a row is 8! = 40 320 ways (8 choices for the first position, 7 for the second, and so on).

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 插空法：先排男演員，再數空隙
title.en: Step 2 · Slot-in: arrange the actors first, then count the gaps

steps.zh: 女演員「不可相鄰」＝插空法。先排 5 位男演員，有 $5! = 120$ 種；他們前後及之間形成 $5 + 1 = 6$ 個空隙。3 位女演員是不同的人，從 6 個空隙中揀 3 個並排序，有 $P^6_3 = 120$ 種。
steps.en: The actresses must not be adjacent, so use the slot-in method. Arrange the 5 actors first: 5! = 120 ways. They create 5 + 1 = 6 gaps. Choose 3 of the 6 gaps and order the 3 distinct actresses: P(6,3) = 120 ways.

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 相乘
title.en: Step 3 · Multiply

steps.zh: 先排男演員、再插女演員是兩個分步，所以兩者相乘：$5! \times P^6_3 = 120 \times 120 = 14400$ 種排法。
steps.en: Multiply the two steps: 5! × P(6,3) = 120 × 120 = 14 400 arrangements.

title.zh: 第 4 步 · 前兩位是男性：由 5 位男演員中選 2 位並排好
title.en: Step 4 · First two are male: choose and order 2 of the 5 actors

steps.zh: 「首兩位分享的人是男性」＝第 1、第 2 個位置都由男演員佔據。由 5 位男演員中選 2 位排在首兩位，有先後之別，用 $P^5_2 = 5 \times 4 = 20$ 種。其餘 6 位表演者（3 位男演員 ＋ 3 位女演員）在餘下 6 個位置任意排列，有 $6! = 720$ 種。
steps.en: 'The first two performers are male' means positions 1 and 2 are taken by actors. Choose and order 2 of the 5 actors: P(5,2) = 5 × 4 = 20 ways. The remaining 6 performers (3 actors and 3 actresses) fill the remaining 6 positions in 6! = 720 ways.

title.zh: 第 5 步 · 相乘
title.en: Step 5 · Multiply

steps.zh: 所以共有 $20 \times 720 = 14400$ 個分享次序。
steps.en: So there are 20 × 720 = 14 400 possible sharing sequences.

title.zh: 第 6 步 · 三個固定位置放女演員
title.en: Step 6 · Three fixed positions hold the actresses

steps.zh: 第 2 位、第 5 位及最後一位＝第 8 位。這 3 個位置只放女演員，3 位女演員自己排有 $3! = 6$ 種；餘下 5 個位置（第 1、3、4、6、7 位）剛好由 5 位男演員填滿，有 $5! = 120$ 種。
steps.en: The 2nd, 5th and last (= 8th) positions hold only actresses: the 3 actresses can be ordered in 3! = 6 ways. The remaining 5 positions (1st, 3rd, 4th, 6th, 7th) are filled by the 5 actors in 5! = 120 ways.

title.zh: 第 7 步 · 相乘
title.en: Step 7 · Multiply

steps.zh: 兩部分獨立，相乘得 $3! \times 5! = 6 \times 120 = 720$ 個分享次序。
steps.en: The two parts are independent, so multiply: 3! × 5! = 6 × 120 = 720 sequences.

traps.label: (a)(ii) 空隙數目少了 1
traps.labelEn: (a)(ii) One gap too few
traps.zh: 5 位男演員形成 $5 + 1 = 6$ 個空隙（包括最前和最後）。若只數男生之間的空隙（4 個）或漏了其中一端，就會用錯 $P$ 的數字。
traps.en: The 5 actors create 5 + 1 = 6 gaps, including the two ends. Counting only the 4 gaps between them, or missing one end, uses the wrong number in P.

traps.label: (a)(ii) 用 C 而不用 P
traps.labelEn: (a)(ii) Using C instead of P
traps.zh: 3 位女演員是不同的人，放入空隙時誰站哪個空隙有分別，要用 $P^6_3 = 120$，不是 $C^6_3 = 20$（用錯只會得 $120 \times 20 = 2400$）。
traps.en: The 3 actresses are distinct, so which gap each takes matters: use P(6,3) = 120, not C(6,3) = 20 (which would wrongly give 120 × 20 = 2400).

traps.label: (b)(i) 前兩位只選不排
traps.labelEn: (b)(i) Choosing the first two without ordering them
traps.zh: 前兩個位置是「第 1 位」和「第 2 位」，先後有分別，所以由 5 位男演員中選 2 位要用 $P^5_2 = 20$，不是 $C^5_2 = 10$。用 $C$ 會少了一半（得 7200）。
traps.en: The first two positions are different (1st and 2nd), so choosing the 2 actors needs P(5,2) = 20, not C(5,2) = 10. Using C halves the answer to 7200.

traps.label: (b)(i) 把首兩位男生當成欽點好的兩個人（2! × 6! = 1440）
traps.labelEn: (b)(i) Treating the first two men as two named people (2! × 6! = 1440)
traps.zh: 首兩位唔係「指定的兩個人」，而係「由 5 位男演員之中揀 2 位排上去」：$P^5_2 = 20$，再乘其餘 6 位的 $6! = 720$，得 $20 \times 720 = 14400$。寫成 $2! \times 6! = 1440$ 就係把第 7(a) 題那種「兩人已經欽點好」的讀法照搬過來，漏了「從 5 位之中選 2 位」這一步：「指定的對象」不用選，「任選 2 位」一定要選。
traps.en: The first two places are not two named people but 'choose 2 of the 5 male actors and put them there': P(5,2) = 20, times 6! = 720 for the rest, giving 20 × 720 = 14 400. Writing 2! × 6! = 1440 copies the 'the two people are already named' reading of Question 7(a) and drops the choosing step: named people need no choosing, 'any 2 of the 5' always does.

traps.label: (b)(i) 用「綑綁法」綁住首兩位男演員（2! × 7! = 10080）
traps.labelEn: (b)(i) Tying the first two men together (2! × 7! = 10 080)
traps.zh: 「綑綁」只用來表達「必須相鄰」；這一題要求兩人佔住第 1、2 位。綁成一塊之後，這一塊可以滑去任何位置（第 2、3 位、第 3、4 位…），所以 $2! \times 7!$（甚至 $7!$）已經唔係「首兩位」。要鎖死位置，就要把 2 位男生直接放入第 1、2 位，而不是綁成一塊再全排。
traps.en: Tying a block only says 'must be adjacent'; here the two men must occupy positions 1 and 2 exactly. Once tied into one block it can slide anywhere (positions 2–3, 3–4, …), so 2! × 7! (or just 7!) no longer means 'the first two'. To pin a position, place the two actors straight into positions 1 and 2 instead of tying and permuting.

traps.label: (b)(ii) 位置數錯（最後一位＝第 8 位）
traps.labelEn: (b)(ii) Miscounting the positions (last = 8th)
traps.zh: 「最後一位」是第 8 位，不是第 7 位。第 2、5、8 位放 3 位女演員，餘下第 1、3、4、6、7 位才是 5 位男演員的位置。
traps.en: The last performer is the 8th, not the 7th. Positions 2, 5 and 8 hold the actresses, leaving positions 1, 3, 4, 6 and 7 for the 5 actors.

traps.label: (b)(ii) 以為 respectively 連出場次序都鎖死（只寫 5! = 120）
traps.labelEn: (b)(ii) Reading 'respectively' as fixing the running order as well (5! = 120 only)
traps.zh: 「respectively」只鎖死「哪位女演員在哪個位」（第 2、5、8 位各有一位），三位女演員之間仍然可以互相調位，有 $3! = 6$ 種。只寫 $5! = 120$ 就是少了這 $3!$，得 $120$ 而不是 $720$；$5! \times 3! = 120 \times 6 = 720$。
traps.en: 'Respectively' only fixes which actress goes to which named position (2nd, 5th, 8th); the three of them can still swap among themselves in 3! = 6 ways. Writing only 5! = 120 drops that 3!, giving 120 instead of 720: 5! × 3! = 120 × 6 = 720.

traps.label: (b)(ii) 畫好八格之後又多乘 8! 或 C(8,3)
traps.labelEn: (b)(ii) Multiplying by 8! or C(8,3) after drawing the eight slots
traps.zh: 八個位置已經被題目鎖定（女演員在第 2、5、8 位），唔需要再「選位」或「全排」。多乘 $C^8_3 = 56$（從 8 位之中揀 3 位放女演員）或 $8! = 40320$ 都會把已經固定的位置重新打亂。
traps.en: The eight positions are already fixed by the question (actresses in the 2nd, 5th and 8th). Nothing is left to choose or permute: multiplying by C(8,3) = 56 (choosing 3 of the 8 slots) or by 8! = 40 320 re-opens decisions the question has already made.

tip.zh: 同一班人「排成一行」與「逐個出場」都是排列，算法一樣；分別只在於題目指定了哪些位置（例如首兩位、第 2／5／8 位）放哪一類人。
tip.en: Standing in a row and sharing one by one are both permutations and are counted the same way; the only difference is which positions are reserved for which group.

stem.en: 10 members of a committee are divided into 4 groups of 1, 2, 3 and 4 members.
stem.zh: 一個委員會的 $10$ 位成員被分成 $4$ 組，人數分別為 $1$、$2$、$3$、$4$ 人。（原卷第 9 題）

keywords.zh: 分成 4 組（逐組抽人，用 $C$）
四組人數各不相同 → 組別本身可分（不用除 $4!$）
分派 4 項不同任務（再把 4 組排列 → 乘 $4!$）

parts.label: (a)
parts.en: In how many different ways can the groups be formed?
parts.zh: 組別共有多少種不同的組成方法？

parts.label: (b)
parts.en: In how many different ways can the 4 groups be assigned to handle 4 different tasks?
parts.zh: 把這 4 組分派去處理 4 項不同的任務，共有多少種方法？

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 逐組抽人（先 1 人組、再 2、3、4 人組）
title.en: Step 1 · Fill the groups one by one (1, then 2, 3, 4)

steps.zh: 由 10 人中選 1 人做 1 人組（$C^{10}_1$）；餘下 9 人選 2 人做 2 人組（$C^9_2$）；餘下 7 人選 3 人做 3 人組（$C^7_3$）；最後 4 人自動成為 4 人組（$C^4_4$）。每一步都是「分步」，所以相乘。
steps.en: Choose 1 of the 10 members for the 1-member group; from the remaining 9 choose 2 for the 2-member group; from the remaining 7 choose 3 for the 3-member group; the last 4 automatically form the 4-member group. Each choice is a step, so multiply.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 計算（並確認不用除 4!）
title.en: Step 2 · Evaluate (and confirm no division by 4!)

steps.en: C(10,1) = 10, C(9,2) = 36, C(7,3) = 35 and C(4,4) = 1, giving 12 600 ways. Since the four groups have different sizes (1, 2, 3, 4), the groups are already distinguishable, so no division by 4! is needed.

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 4 項任務不同 → 4 組要「派位」
title.en: Step 3 · Four different tasks means the four groups are assigned

steps.zh: 分好組之後，要把 4 組分別派去 4 項不同的任務：等於把 4 組排列到 4 個任務之上，有 $4! = 24$ 種。這一步是新的分步，所以乘在 (a) 的答案之上。
steps.en: Once the groups are formed, they must be assigned to the 4 different tasks — the 4 groups are arranged among the 4 tasks in 4! = 24 ways. This is a further step, so multiply the answer of (a).

title.zh: 第 4 步 · 計算
title.en: Step 4 · Evaluate

steps.zh: 所以共有 $12600 \times 24 = 302400$ 種分派方法。
steps.en: So there are 12 600 × 24 = 302 400 ways of assigning the groups.

traps.label: (a) 多除了 4!
traps.labelEn: (a) Dividing by 4! unnecessarily
traps.zh: 只有在「分成幾個大小相同的組」時才需要除以 $k!$。本題四組人數 $1$、$2$、$3$、$4$ 各不相同，每組都可以憑人數分辨，所以 $12600$ 不用再除 $4!$（除錯會得 $525$）。
traps.en: Division by k! is only needed when the groups have the same size. Here the sizes 1, 2, 3 and 4 are all different, so the groups are distinguishable by size; 12 600 needs no division by 4! (doing so gives the wrong 525).

traps.label: (a) 把「分組」當成「排列」
traps.labelEn: (a) Treating grouping as arranging
traps.zh: 組內不計次序，所以用 $C$ 而不是 $P$。$P^{10}_1 P^9_2 P^7_3 P^4_4 = 10 \times 72 \times 210 \times 24 = 3628800 = 10!$ 是錯的：那等於把每一位成員都當成佔據一個有次序的位置。
traps.en: Within a group the order does not matter, so use C, not P. Using P(10,1)P(9,2)P(7,3)P(4,4) = 3 628 800 = 10! is wrong: it treats every member as occupying an ordered position.

traps.label: (a) 每一次都由 10 人重新抽（385）
traps.labelEn: (a) Drawing from all 10 people every time (385)
traps.zh: 抽走的人唔會再出現，所以每一次的人數都要逐步扣：$C^{10}_1 \times C^9_2 \times C^7_3 \times C^4_4 = 12600$。四個組合都寫 10（$C^{10}_1 + C^{10}_2 + C^{10}_3 + C^{10}_4 = 385$，或者四個相乘）就係冇把「已經抽走的人」扣出來；1 人組抽完之後只剩 9 人、再抽 2 人之後只剩 7 人。
traps.en: People already drawn cannot be drawn again, so the pool shrinks at every step: C(10,1) × C(9,2) × C(7,3) × C(4,4) = 12 600. Using 10 in all four factors (C(10,1) + C(10,2) + C(10,3) + C(10,4) = 385, or the same four multiplied) never removes the people already chosen: after the group of 1 only 9 remain, and after the pair only 7.

traps.label: (a) 只看見 4 和 10 就寫 C(10,4) = 210
traps.labelEn: (a) Seeing only '4' and '10' and writing C(10,4) = 210
traps.zh: 「分成 1、2、3、4 人的四組」唔係「從 10 人之中揀 4 人」：$C^{10}_4 = 210$ 只揀了 4 個人，而且冇分成四組。要按每組的人數逐組抽：先抽 1 人，再從剩下 9 人抽 2 人，如此類推。
traps.en: 'Divided into 4 groups of 1, 2, 3 and 4 members' is not 'choose 4 of the 10': C(10,4) = 210 picks four people and forms no groups at all. Draw one group at a time — 1 person first, then 2 from the remaining 9, and so on.

traps.label: (b) 只乘 4 或忘記乘 4!
traps.labelEn: (b) Multiplying by 4 only, or forgetting to multiply by 4!
traps.zh: 4 項任務不同，4 組派去 4 個任務是「全排列」$4! = 24$，不是 $4$（乘 4 會得 $50400$），也不能不乘（不乘只得 $12600$，即正確數目的 $\frac{1}{24}$）。這一題最常見的兩種寫法：只答 $4! = 24$（即忘了把 (a) 的 $12600$ 乘入去：$12600 \times 4! = 302400$），或者把「4 組派 4 個任務」當成 $4 \times 4 = 16$。
traps.en: The four tasks are different, so assigning the four groups to them is a full permutation, 4! = 24 — not 4 (which gives 50 400), and it cannot be skipped (skipping leaves 12 600, under-counting by a factor of 24). The two commonest answers on the paper were 4! = 24 on its own (forgetting to multiply in the 12 600 from (a): 12 600 × 4! = 302 400) and treating '4 groups into 4 tasks' as 4 × 4 = 16.

tip.zh: 「分組」用 $C$ 逐組抽人；「分派任務」才乘 $4!$。只有「幾個大小相同的組」才需要除以組數的階乘（下一題就是這種）。
tip.en: Grouping uses C group by group; assigning tasks multiplies by 4!. Division by k! is only for equal-sized groups (the next question is that case).

stem.en: Employees of a department are divided into groups A and B. There are 5 male employees and 3 female employees in group A. There are 6 male employees and 2 female employees in group B. 2 employees are selected from each group for training.
stem.zh: 某部門的員工分成 A、B 兩組。A 組有 $5$ 位男員工和 $3$ 位女員工；B 組有 $6$ 位男員工和 $2$ 位女員工。現從每組各選 $2$ 位員工參加培訓。（原卷第 10 題）

keywords.en: 2 employees are selected from each group
keywords.zh: 每組各選 2 位（共 4 人）
每組各 1 男 1 女

keywords.en: the numbers of male and female employees selected are different
keywords.zh: 選出的男、女人數不同（反面＝2 男 2 女）

parts.label: (a)
parts.en: Find the number of different ways of selection if there is no restriction.
parts.zh: 若沒有任何限制，求不同的選法數目。

parts.label: (b)
parts.en: Find the number of different ways of selection if 1 male employee and 1 female employee are selected from each group.
parts.zh: 若每組各選 1 位男員工和 1 位女員工，求不同的選法數目。

parts.label: (c)
parts.en: Find the number of different ways of selection if the numbers of male employees and female employees selected are different.
parts.zh: 若選出的男員工人數與女員工人數不同，求不同的選法數目。

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 每組各選 2 人（不計次序）
title.en: Step 1 · Choose 2 from each group (order ignored)

steps.zh: A 組有 $5 + 3 = 8$ 人，選 2 人有 $C^8_2$ 種；B 組同樣有 $6 + 2 = 8$ 人，也有 $C^8_2$ 種。兩組是分步的關係，相乘。
steps.en: Group A has 5 + 3 = 8 employees, and choosing 2 of them gives C(8,2) ways; group B also has 6 + 2 = 8 employees, again C(8,2) ways. The two groups are consecutive steps, so multiply.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 計算
title.en: Step 2 · Evaluate

steps.zh: $C^8_2 = \frac{8 \times 7}{2 \times 1} = 28$。A、B 兩組各有 8 人，每組選 2 人都是 28 種，所以共有 $28 \times 28 = 784$ 種選法。
steps.en: C(8,2) = 8 × 7 ÷ 2 = 28, so there are 28 × 28 = 784 ways of selection.

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 每組「1 男 1 女」
title.en: Step 3 · 'One male and one female' from each group

steps.zh: A 組：由 5 位男員工選 1 位（$C^5_1$）、由 3 位女員工選 1 位（$C^3_1$），分步相乘得 $15$ 種。B 組：由 6 位男員工選 1 位、由 2 位女員工選 1 位，得 $12$ 種。兩組再用乘法。
steps.en: Group A: choose 1 of the 5 male employees and 1 of the 3 female employees: 5 × 3 = 15 ways. Group B: choose 1 of the 6 male and 1 of the 2 female employees: 6 × 2 = 12 ways. Multiply the two groups.

title.zh: 第 4 步 · 計算
title.en: Step 4 · Evaluate

steps.zh: 所以共有 $15 \times 12 = 180$ 種選法：A 組的 15 種配上 B 組的 12 種。
steps.en: So there are 15 × 12 = 180 ways of selection.

title.zh: 第 5 步 · 「男女人數不同」用反面：總數 −「2 男 2 女」
title.en: Step 5 · Use the complement: total − the '2 male, 2 female' cases

steps.zh: 共選 4 人，「男女人數不同」的反面就是「男女人數相同」，即 2 男 2 女。用 (a) 的總數減去所有「2 男 2 女」的情況最快。
steps.en: Four employees are selected, so 'the numbers of male and female employees are different' fails exactly when the selection is 2 male and 2 female. Take the total from (a) and subtract every '2M2F' case.

title.zh: 第 6 步 · 數齊三個「2 男 2 女」的情況
title.en: Step 6 · Count all three '2 male, 2 female' cases

steps.zh: 「2 男 2 女」有三種情況：① 每組各 1 男 1 女＝（b）的 $180$ 種；② A 組 2 男、B 組 2 女＝$C^5_2 C^2_2 = 10 \times 1 = 10$ 種；③ A 組 2 女、B 組 2 男＝$C^3_2 C^6_2 = 3 \times 15 = 45$ 種。三種都要減，缺一不可。
steps.en: There are three 2M2F cases: (1) one male and one female from each group: 180 from (b); (2) 2 males from A and 2 females from B: C(5,2)C(2,2) = 10 × 1 = 10; (3) 2 females from A and 2 males from B: C(3,2)C(6,2) = 3 × 15 = 45. All three must be subtracted.

title.zh: 第 7 步 · 相減
title.en: Step 7 · Subtract

steps.en: So the number of ways with different numbers of male and female employees is 784 − 180 − 10 − 45 = 549.

name.zh: 方法二 · 直接數六個情況（不用反面）
name.en: Method 2 · Count the six cases directly (no complement)

alt.en: With 4 people selected, 'different numbers of male and female employees' means 4M0F, 3M1F, 1M3F or 0M4F. Listing the male/female split of each group gives six mutually exclusive cases: (1) A 2M0F, B 2M0F: C(5,2)C(6,2) = 10 × 15 = 150; (2) A 2M0F, B 1M1F: C(5,2)C(6,1)C(2,1) = 10 × 12 = 120; (3) A 1M1F, B 2M0F: C(5,1)C(3,1)C(6,2) = 15 × 15 = 225; (4) A 1M1F, B 0M2F: C(5,1)C(3,1)C(2,2) = 15 × 1 = 15; (5) A 0M2F, B 1M1F: C(3,2)C(6,1)C(2,1) = 3 × 12 = 36; (6) A 0M2F, B 0M2F: C(3,2)C(2,2) = 3 × 1 = 3. Adding the six cases: 150 + 120 + 225 + 15 + 36 + 3 = 549, the same as the complement method.

traps.label: (a) 用 $P$ 而不是 $C$
traps.labelEn: (a) Using P instead of C
traps.zh: 選人去培訓是一組人，不計次序，要用 $C^8_2 = 28$。用 $P^8_2 = 56$ 會得 $56 \times 56 = 3136$。
traps.en: Selecting employees for training is a set of people, so order does not matter: use C(8,2) = 28. Using P(8,2) = 56 wrongly gives 56 × 56 = 3136.

traps.label: (a) 兩組之間用加號（56）
traps.labelEn: (a) Joining the two groups with a plus sign (56)
traps.zh: 「A 組抽 2 人 而且 B 組抽 2 人」兩步都要做，所以相乘：$28 \times 28 = 784$。用加號（$C^8_2 + C^8_2 = 28 + 28 = 56$）就變成「A 組或者 B 組」，概念調轉了。留意 56 這個數：用 $P$ 而不用 $C$ 都會得到 56，兩個錯法的答案一樣，但成因不同。
traps.en: Two are drawn from A and also two from B — both steps happen, so multiply: 28 × 28 = 784. A plus sign (C(8,2) + C(8,2) = 28 + 28 = 56) turns it into 'A or B'. Note the number 56: using P instead of C also gives 56 — the same wrong answer from a different mistake.

traps.label: (b) 兩組之間用加而不是乘
traps.labelEn: (b) Adding the two groups instead of multiplying
traps.zh: 「每組各 1 男 1 女」＝ A 組的 $15$ 種配上 B 組的 $12$ 種，是分步相乘：$15 \times 12 = 180$。寫成 $15 + 12 = 27$ 是錯的。
traps.en: 'One male and one female from each group' pairs the 15 ways of group A with the 12 ways of group B, so multiply: 15 × 12 = 180. Writing 15 + 12 = 27 is wrong.

traps.label: (c) 只減去 (b) 的 180
traps.labelEn: (c) Subtracting only the 180 from (b)
traps.zh: 「2 男 2 女」不止「每組各 1 男 1 女」這一種：還有「A 組 2 男、B 組 2 女」（$10$ 種）及「A 組 2 女、B 組 2 男」（$45$ 種）。只減 $180$ 會得 $604$，是常見錯答。
traps.en: '2 male and 2 female' is not only 'one male and one female per group': it also includes 2 males from A with 2 females from B (10 ways) and 2 females from A with 2 males from B (45 ways). Subtracting only 180 gives the common wrong answer 604.

traps.label: (c) 直接數六個情況時漏掉整個性別的情況
traps.labelEn: (c) Missing the all-one-sex cases when counting directly
traps.zh: 用加法直接數時，最容易漏掉「4 男 0 女」（$150$ 種）和「0 男 4 女」（$3$ 種）這兩個沒有男女混合的情況。
traps.en: When adding the cases directly, the two single-sex cases are the easiest to miss: 4 males and 0 females (150 ways) and 0 males and 4 females (3 ways).

traps.label: (c) 無視 A、B 兩組的邊界
traps.labelEn: (c) Ignoring the boundary between groups A and B
traps.zh: 題目規定「每組各抽 2 人」，所以 A、B 兩組的邊界一定要保留。把兩組合成 11 男 5 女再抽 4 人，就會出現「A 組抽 3 人、B 組抽 1 人」這類題目唔准許的選法。合併之後無論用 $C$ 定係分類相加，答案都唔會對。
traps.en: '2 employees from each group' fixes how many come from A and from B, so the boundary must stay. Merging the two groups into 11 males and 5 females and then choosing 4 can produce selections such as 3 from A and 1 from B, which the question does not allow — the total will be wrong however it is counted.

traps.label: (c) 誤解成「每組內部不可以 1 男 1 女」（13 × 16 = 208）
traps.labelEn: (c) Misreading it as 'no group may be 1 male + 1 female' (13 × 16 = 208)
traps.zh: 把「男女人數不同」讀成「兩組都唔可以 1 男 1 女」：A 組「唔係 1 男 1 女」有 $C^5_2 + C^3_2 = 10 + 3 = 13$ 種，B 組有 $C^6_2 + C^2_2 = 15 + 1 = 16$ 種，相乘得 $13 \times 16 = 208$。但題目講的是 4 人合起來的男女總數：A 組 1 男 1 女、B 組 2 男（合共 3 男 1 女）其實符合題意，208 漏了這一類；而 A 組 2 男、B 組 2 女（合共 2 男 2 女）唔符合，208 又把它算進去了。
traps.en: Reading 'different numbers of males and females' as 'neither group may be 1 male + 1 female': group A has C(5,2) + C(3,2) = 10 + 3 = 13 such selections, group B has C(6,2) + C(2,2) = 15 + 1 = 16, giving 13 × 16 = 208. But the condition is on the total across the four people: 1 male + 1 female from A together with 2 males from B (3 males, 1 female) does satisfy it and is missing from 208, while 2 males from A with 2 females from B (2 males, 2 females) breaks it and should not be there.

tip.zh: 「男女人數不同」有兩條路：反面（總數 − 男女人數相同）或直接數所有互斥情況。反面做要數齊「相同」的所有組合方式，少數一個都會錯；直接數就要留意沒有男女混合的情況。
tip.en: 'Different numbers of males and females' can be done by complement (total minus equal-numbers cases) or by listing the mutually exclusive cases. The complement route needs every equal case; the direct route must not miss the single-sex cases.

stem.en: 20 children are divided into 4 groups and each group has 5 children. Someone claims that the number of ways is equal to $C^{20}_{5} \times C^{15}_{5} \times C^{10}_{5} \times C^{5}_{5} = 11\,732\,745\,024$. Do you agree? Explain your answer.
stem.zh: 把 $20$ 個小朋友分成 $4$ 組，每組 $5$ 人。有人聲稱方法數等於 $C^{20}_5 \times C^{15}_5 \times C^{10}_5 \times C^5_5 = 11\,732\,745\,024$。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。（原卷加分題第 11 題）

keywords.en: divided into 4 groups and each group has 5 children
keywords.zh: 4 組人數完全相同（各 5 人）

keywords.en: Do you agree? Explain your answer.
keywords.zh: 是否同意（要寫出理由與正確數目）

keywords.en: the order of selecting the groups should not be considered
keywords.zh: 組的抽取次序不影響分組結果 → 要除以 $4!$

parts.en: Do you agree? Explain your answer.
parts.zh: 你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。

note.zh: 不同意；正確數目是 488 864 376 種

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 指出問題：4 組人數相同，不應考慮抽取次序
title.en: Step 1 · Identify the issue: the 4 equal-sized groups are unlabelled

steps.zh: 聲稱的式子 $C^{20}_5 C^{15}_5 C^{10}_5 C^5_5$ 是「逐組抽人」，隱含了「第 1、2、3、4 組」的先後次序。但題目的 4 組都是 5 人，組與組之間沒有名稱或標籤，把 4 組的抽取次序調轉其實是同一個分組結果，因此聲稱的式子把每個結果重複計了 $4! = 24$ 次。
steps.en: The claimed expression C(20,5)C(15,5)C(10,5)C(5,5) draws the groups in sequence, treating 'Groups 1, 2, 3, 4' as distinct. However, all 4 groups have 5 children and no labels; permuting the order in which the 4 groups are drawn gives the exact same partition, so every division is over-counted 4! = 24 times.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 但這個數「多計」了：4 組大小相同，要除以 4!
title.en: Step 2 · But it over-counts: the 4 equal groups must be divided by 4!

steps.zh: 4 組都是 5 人，組與組之間沒有名字、沒有分別：先把 {甲、乙、丙、丁、戊} 抽成「第 1 組」，再把其餘的人抽成「第 2 組」，與把兩組的抽取次序調轉，其實是同一個分組結果。這個「抽取次序」被重複計了 $4! = 24$ 次，所以要除以 $4!$：正確數目是 $488\,864\,376$ 種。
steps.en: All four groups have 5 children and the groups have no names or labels: taking {A, B, C, D, E} as 'group 1' and then forming 'group 2' from the rest gives the same division of children as swapping the order in which those two groups are drawn. That drawing order is counted 4! = 24 times over, so divide by 4!: the correct number is 488 864 376.

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 結論：不同意
title.en: Step 3 · Conclusion: disagree

steps.en: The correct number 488 864 376 is not equal to the claimed 11 732 745 024 (the claim is 24 times too large), so we do not agree.

traps.label: 忘記除以 4!
traps.labelEn: Forgetting to divide by 4!
traps.zh: 4 組人數相同，「誰是先抽出的第 1 組」並不重要；不除以 $4!$ 就會把每個分組結果重複數 24 次，得出聲稱的 $11\,732\,745\,024$（同意它是錯的）。
traps.en: The four groups have the same size, so which one was drawn first does not matter; without dividing by 4! every division is counted 24 times, giving the claimed 11 732 745 024 — agreeing with it is wrong.

traps.label: 把「不用除」的情況搞混（與第 9 題比較）
traps.labelEn: Confusing this with a case that needs no division (compare Question 9)
traps.zh: 第 9 題的四組人數是 $1$、$2$、$3$、$4$，組別可以憑人數分辨，所以不用除。本題 4 組都是 5 人，互換之後完全一樣，所以必須除以 $4!$。把第 9 題那種（$1$、$2$、$3$、$4$ 人）都除 $4!$，就會得到錯的 $12600 \div 4! = 525$ —— 同一條公式，用在唔同大小嘅組就會錯。
traps.en: In Question 9 the groups have 1, 2, 3 and 4 members, so they are distinguishable by size and no division is needed. Here all four groups have 5 children and swapping them changes nothing, so division by 4! is required. Dividing the Question 9 answer (groups of 1, 2, 3 and 4) by 4! wrongly gives 12 600 ÷ 4! = 525: the same rule misapplied to groups of different sizes.

traps.label: 只答「不同意」而沒有解釋
traps.labelEn: Answering 'disagree' without explanation
traps.zh: 這題 3 分：要寫出聲稱的數目是「多計了」（並解釋重複了 $4!$ 次）以及正確數目 $488\,864\,376$。只寫「不同意」拿不到分。
traps.en: This question is worth 3 marks: state that the claim over-counts (explaining the repeated 4!), and give the correct value 488 864 376. A bare 'disagree' earns nothing.

tip.zh: 分組題記住一句：「幾個大小相同的組，就要除以組數的階乘」。4 組各 5 人 → 除以 $4!$；四組人數不同（如 1、2、3、4）→ 甚麼都不用除。
tip.en: Remember one rule for grouping: if several groups have the same size, divide by the factorial of the number of groups. Four groups of 5 → divide by 4!; four groups of different sizes (e.g. 1, 2, 3, 4) → divide by nothing.

introSteps.zh: 網站的題號 A1–A5、B1–B5、Bonus 對應原卷第 1–5 題、第 6–10 題及加分題第 11 題，每題一頁。
introSteps.en: Site codes A1–A5, B1–B5 and Bonus correspond to Questions 1–5, 6–10 and the bonus Question 11 on the paper. One question per page.

introSteps.zh: 題目英文措辭與原卷一致；詳解中英對照，並附 (1M) 方法分、(1A) 答案分，方便核對自己有沒有拿到分。
introSteps.en: Question wording follows the original paper; explanations are bilingual and carry the (1M) method and (1A) accuracy marks so you can check whether you earned each mark.

introSteps.zh: 「題目字眼」那一列，是讀題時最容易漏看的英文（例如 at least、exactly、no ... next to each other）。
introSteps.en: The 'words in the question' row flags the English wording students most often miss (e.g. at least, exactly, no ... stand next to each other).
